subject: english
question:
**Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word in the following sentence.**

There are some technologies available today that make a notebook __dispensable__.
solution:
The correct answer is:** Essential**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Dispensable** means capable of being dispensed with or done without; not necessary or essential.

 *** • Example- ******Computers have made typewriters dispensable.***

 
• Marked option **Essential **means a thing that is absolutely necessary.

 *** • Example- ******Mistakes are an essential part of education.***

 
• So, It is clear that **Dispensable and Essential** are **opposite in meaning.**

Therefore the correct answer is **option 3.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Acceptable** means satisfactory and able to be agreed to or approved of.
 
• **Urgent** means requiring immediate action or attention.
 
• **Popular** means liked or admired by many people or by a particular person or group.
